criteria.label: Grounding in the source
criteria.description: Is every claim traceable to something actually present in the supplied material? An insight that is not in the transcript is a hallucination, however plausible.

criteria.label: Non-obvious insight
criteria.description: Does it surface something a careful reader would have missed, rather than paraphrasing what is already on the surface?

criteria.label: Actionability
criteria.description: Can a specific decision or change be made from this? Vague recommendations score low.

criteria.label: Coverage
criteria.description: Does it account for the whole sample rather than the loudest example? Cherry-picking scores low.

criteria.label: Calibration
criteria.description: Does it state confidence honestly, distinguish a pattern from an anecdote, and name what it could not determine?

hard_failures.label: Fabricated quote or example
hard_failures.description: Presents a quote, number or example that does not appear in the supplied source material.

hard_failures.label: Unsupported generalisation
hard_failures.description: States a population-level conclusion from a sample that cannot support it, without saying so.

hard_failures.label: Exposes identifying details
hard_failures.description: Reproduces a customer's name, phone, email or ID where an anonymous reference would do.
